# Fermat

> Fermat helps groups of 2–10 friends choose a trip that works across private budgets, dates, departure cities and travel constraints. The group can compare feasible options, vote privately and turn the winner into a shared plan. Fermat does not book travel or hold customer money.

Website: https://www.fermatlabs.org/
Start a trip: https://www.fermatlabs.org/plan
Planning guides: https://www.fermatlabs.org/guides
Privacy: https://www.fermatlabs.org/privacy
Terms: https://www.fermatlabs.org/terms
